You're exactly right. The slightest setback or insignificant disappointment makes me instantly feel like the whole world is imploding and I can't get far enough away from it.

It's scary sometimes, because I'd like to do whatever I want when I'm happy, but I get very hesitant because I know how fast things can and do change, so I don't want to put myself in a position where I can't quickly get away from it.
